findings.current: His face was firmer than I had ever seen it as he looked at me and continued.
findings.defect: “His face was firmer” is an unnatural literal rendering of an unusually grave or stern expression.
findings.rationale: 굳은 얼굴 describes Jeok Cheongang’s grave, hardened expression, not the physical firmness of his face.
findings.replacement: His expression was graver than ever as he looked at me and continued.
findings.source: 어느 때보다 굳은 얼굴을 한 그가 나를 바라보며 말을 이었다.

findings.current: And now, I suppose I will see it through to the very end.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the guardian spirit’s statement that it and the sacred stone will remain together until the end with a generic declaration of perseverance.
findings.rationale: 함께하게 되겠구나 explicitly emphasizes the guardian spirit and the sacred stone being together, an important emotional culmination of their lifelong bond.
findings.replacement: And now, it seems we will be together until the very end.
findings.source: 그리고 이제, 그 마지막까지 함께하게 되겠구나.

findings.current:
Its footsteps were heavier than ever, but they were also footsteps no one could stop.

The darkness was the same. It had grown far denser and stickier than it had been at the beginning.
findings.defect: The second paragraph fails to state that even the greatly thickened darkness could not stop the guardian spirit’s advance; instead, “The darkness was the same” leaves the relationship unclear and merely describes the darkness.
findings.rationale: 어둠조차 마찬가지였다 carries forward the preceding claim that nothing could stop those steps, making the darkness another obstacle unable to halt the guardian spirit.
findings.replacement:
Its footsteps were heavier than ever, but they were also footsteps no one could stop.

Not even the darkness, now incomparably denser and stickier than at first, could stop them.
findings.source:
그 어느 때보다 무거운 발걸음이었으나, 누구도 막을 수 없는 걸음이기도 했다.

그것은 처음과는 비교도 할 수 없을 만큼 짙고, 끈적해진 어둠조차 마찬가지였다.

findings.current: Along with a question that would never be heard, the guardian spirit forced itself through the wide split in the cliff.
findings.defect: The draft turns a single step taken with all its strength into a completed movement through the fissure and omits the explicit exertion.
findings.rationale: 온 힘을 다해 걸음을 내디뎠다 specifically describes taking a step with all its strength; it does not yet say that the guardian spirit passed through the fissure.
findings.replacement: With that unheard question, the guardian spirit took a step with all its strength into the gaping fissure in the cliff.
findings.source: 들리지 않을 물음과 함께, 수호령은 쩍 벌어진 절벽 틈새로 온 힘을 다해 걸음을 내디뎠다.

findings.current: With a soft tap, the leaf struck the ground, and a being enjoying an afternoon nap opened its eyes.
findings.defect: The draft invents the leaf striking the ground, but the source describes the sleeping being feeling the soft impact and waking.
findings.rationale: 부딪히는 감촉 is the tactile sensation that wakes the sleeping White Tiger; having the leaf strike the ground changes the physical action and breaks the causal link.
findings.replacement: At the soft tap of the leaf landing on it, a being enjoying an afternoon nap opened its eyes.
findings.source: 툭, 하고 부딪히는 감촉과 함께 낮잠을 즐기던 어느 존재가 눈을 떴다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it contains one changed physical action, several omitted mechanical or emotional details, and one localized wording issue.
